name: READY RECKONERS
description: Our ready Reckoning aids, such as the abacus, slide rule, math maps and calculator, have been used to help students perform calculations more efficiently and accurately. Our tools are evolved. Reckoning aids have played an important role in math education, and continue to be an important tool for helping students learn and master mathematical concepts.

name: INTERACTIVE MATH ENVIRONMENTS
description: over 200 math activities are designed to engage and inspire students of all ages and skill levels. These activities include a wide range of options, such as wall activities, apps, activity desks, kiosks, interactive walls, and more.

name: ACTIVITY DESKS
description: Each carefully designed kiosk turns complex topics into exciting adventures. From “Number Explorers” where students master number theory through dynamic challenges, to “Fraction Factory” where abstract concepts become tangible through interactive games. Our “Shape Shifters” geometry station uses augmented reality to make spatial reasoning fun, while “Data Detectives” turns statistics into exciting investigations.

name: UPCOMING FEATURES
description:
Math Lab Journal System: Digital portfolios where students document their mathematical thinking and progress
Virtual Math Mentor Program: AI-powered virtual tutors available 24/7
Math Through Art Station: Area exploring mathematical concepts through artistic expression
Real-World Math Connection Corner: Displays showing practical applications of math in various careers
Parent Connect Portal: Platform for parents to track their child’s progress and engage in family math activities

name: MATH CHALLENGES
description: Regular challenges keep students engaged and motivated. These range from daily mini-quests to monthly team competitions. Problems are designed to develop critical thinking and real-world application skills, similar to those found in mathematical olympiads.

name: COLLABORATIVE /COMMUNITY LEARNING
description: Comfortable areas where students can relax while engaging with mathematical concepts. These zones feature math-themed board games, puzzle stations, and informal learning spaces. The casual atmosphere encourages peer tutoring and mathematical discussions outside formal instruction time.

name: CURRICULUM MAPPED
description: Every activity and game in the lab is carefully aligned with the school’s mathematics curriculum. For instance, if students are learning fractions in class, they might encounter fraction-themed digital games, physical puzzles, and wall activities that reinforce these concepts. This ensures that playtime directly supports learning objectives.

name: WALL KIOSKS
description: Each carefully designed kiosk turns complex topics into exciting adventures. From “Number Explorers” where students master number theory through dynamic challenges, to “Fraction Factory” where abstract concepts become tangible through interactive games. Our “Shape Shifters” geometry station uses augmented reality to make spatial reasoning fun, while “Data Detectives” turns statistics into exciting investigations.

name: MATH LAB DESIGN TO SETUP
description: The lab’s aesthetics blend mathematical concepts with modern design. Fibonacci spirals, golden ratios, and fractal patterns are incorporated into the decor.

name: AI POWERED MATH APPS
description: Tablets loaded with artificial intelligence-driven mathematics applications provide personalized learning experiences. These apps adapt to each student’s pace and learning style, offering customized problem sets and explanations. The AI tracks student progress, identifies knowledge gaps, and suggests targeted practice activities.

name: GAMIFICATION IN MATH
description: The lab transforms traditional math learning into an engaging, game-based experience. Students earn points, badges, and rewards as they progress through different mathematical concepts. Real-time leaderboards foster healthy competition, while collaborative challenges encourage teamwork. For instance, students might solve a series of algebra puzzles to “unlock” new levels or participate in math-themed escape room scenarios.

name: MATH MANIPULATIVES
description: The lab is equipped with both physical and digital manipulatives that bring abstract mathematical concepts to life. From tangible base-10 blocks and geometric shapes to digital fraction towers and algebra tiles, these tools help students visualize complex concepts. For example, students can physically manipulate 3D shapes to understand volume, or use digital balance beams to grasp algebraic equations.

name: MATH FURNITURE
description: The furniture is designed with mathematics in mind – tables with built-in coordinate grids, chairs with geometric patterns, and modular seating that can be arranged to demonstrate concepts like tessellation. Whiteboards are integrated into table surfaces, allowing students to work out problems collaboratively. Height-adjustable desks accommodate different learning styles and group configurations.

name: Digital Content Authoring & Whiteboard Tools
description:
With tools like KITABOO, Flipsnack, and BrightClass, schools can create interactive digital textbooks, assessments, and multimedia-rich lessons.
Each platform supports SCORM-compliant output, cloud syncing, multi-language input, and DRM encryption. Subscriptions come with onboarding, cloud backup, and analytics dashboards for administrators.

name: Augmented & Virtual Reality Content Platform
description:
Our AR/VR content library—powered by zSpace Studio and Merge EDU—offers immersive, curriculum-mapped content in STEM, social studies, and arts.
The platform includes LMS integration, usage analytics, and custom lesson design tools. Regular updates ensure alignment with global standards (NGSS, CBSE, IB). Licenses come with unlimited teacher access, and 24×7 remote support.

name: Formative Assessments & Collaborative Reading Tools
description:
Platforms like Perusall and Edulastic enable continuous assessment through real-time quizzes, peer interaction, and learning analytics.
Features include adaptive testing, rubric-based evaluation, and integration with Google Classroom, Teams, and Schoology. All licenses are SLA-backed with uptime guarantees and academic-year renewals

name: AI enabled Interactive flat panel supply & installation
description: We curate classroom-ready interactive flat panels—designed for teaching, not boardroom demos. Each panel is sourced from trusted manufacturers and configured with education-focused software, AI-assisted teaching tools, multi-user touch, and curriculum-aligned content. We handle end-to-end delivery: installation, teacher onboarding, calibration, AMC, and on-site support—ensuring reliable performance, high teacher adoption, and smarter, more engaging classrooms without IT complexity.

name: AR/VR Laptops & Touch Desktops (zSpace)
description:
Our zSpace Inspire Pro systems combine AR/VR with stylus interactivity, offering immersive simulations in biology, physics, coding, and more—without requiring VR headsets.
Built with Intel Core i7 processors, 16GB RAM, and discrete GPU, these all-in-one units are optimized for school labs with IT-friendly admin tools. Devices come with 3-year full warranty, remote troubleshooting, and curriculum-aligned content library updates.

name: Student Tablets
description: We supply durable, education-specific student tablets like the Amplify Tablet—featuring Octa-core processors, Android 14, MIL-STD-810G-certified rugged housing, and battery life up to 10 hours. These devices come pre-configured with mobile device management (MDM), classroom control tools, and content libraries. Each unit includes a 1-year warranty (extendable up to 3 years), with optional screen damage protection and theft/loss coverage.
